rules: Source: media/_all, the game and in-game-animation folders, deduped by content hash (159 different pictures). Nothing else in the source tree is a picture of the game: the in-game-animation recordings under media/_others are videos, the emotes and skill icons are in the Others collection and the 3D model textures belong to the 3D Models room, and the gameplay clips and skin showcase thumbnails are posters of videos.
Size floor: a picture whose long side is under 480 px (the row thumbnail) is dropped, because nothing is upscaled and it would look soft in a row.

A picture shows a player's file name burned in at the bottom (idle.mkv, face.mkv, foot.mkv, zoom.mkv, horizontal.mkv, vertical.mkv). The bottom 112 px (the text sits in rows 1048 to 1098 of 1152) are cut away. A black bar of 16 px at the bottom of one drone picture and the transparent margin of 14 px around the round icon are cut away too. No other picture is cropped.

chars lists the Aspirants that can be seen: a face, a body, a gloved hand or a large chibi shown on a hologram. A face icon in a ranking board, a small badge in a HUD, Tetra alone and a card held in a hand do not count. Where a picture sits in the folders of an Aspirant and nothing contradicts it, the folders decide. places always lists every folder the picture was found in and is never changed.
A facet counts a picture when the facet id is in its places or in its chars. Character slugs and folder slugs are the same ids.
Frames of one animation that differ in pose, framing or effect are kept. The closest pair (Guinevere, 204011 and 204016) is two poses of the same moment.

credit.animation: A still from the game's in-game animation, supplied by the site's owner.
credit.interface: A game interface image, supplied by the site's owner.
